dell-299281.text:
Software Principal Engineer – Autonomous AI Software Engineering
Software engineering is being reshaped by autonomous AI agents that can plan, write, test, and review code with increasing independence. Our team works at the forefront of that shift, bringing agent-driven autonomy into the software development lifecycle so that engineers set direction and make key decisions while agents handle more execution.
Because the agent landscape evolves rapidly, we stay hands-on: exploring the most promising approaches, proving them with rigorous experiments on real engineering work, and turning successful patterns into standard development practices. We are a small, AI-native team operating like a startup—prioritizing high autonomy, rapid experimentation, and daily human-AI collaboration.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact as a Software Principal Engineer on our AI Governance Engineering team in Hopkinton, Massachusetts . This is an onsite role .
What You'll Achieve
You will be the hands-on engineer who turns autonomous agents from impressive demos into dependable engineering practice. You will set up and run proofs of concept of agent platforms and approaches against real codebases and tasks, measure objectively what they can and cannot do, and integrate viable solutions into our development lifecycle—operating within the architecture and evaluation framework defined by our architect.
You will spend most of your time building and experimenting (70%+), using AI agents as a core part of your daily workflow.
Key Responsibilities:
Run hands-on proofs of concept and pilots of autonomous software-engineering agents and agent platforms, from environment setup and integration through results, on representative real-world engineering work
Build evaluation harnesses: realistic task suites, benchmarks, and metrics for output quality, level of autonomy, reliability, speed, cost, and security, enabling fair and repeatable comparisons
Verify and validate agent output using automated tests, mutation testing, static and security analysis, acceptance-criteria checks, and calibrated human review to identify failure points
Integrate agents into the engineering toolchain (source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, specifications, and quality gates) via APIs, MCP, and custom tools, building extensions where standard solutions fall short
Increase autonomy safely by implementing guardrails, sandboxing, observability (traces and replay), and feedback loops, helping engineering teams adopt agent-driven workflows with confidence
Technologies You'll Work With:
Agents and LLMs: Commercial and open-source autonomous coding agents, agent frameworks, frontier and open-weight models, LLM gateways, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Engineering: Python, TypeScript / Node.js, REST and GraphQL APIs, Git-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines
Verification and Validation: Automated test frameworks, test-driven development (TDD), mutation and property-based testing, static and security analysis, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Runtime and Observability: Docker and Kubernetes for sandboxed agent execution, OpenTelemetry tracing, metrics, dashboards, and PostgreSQL
Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here is what we are looking for with this role:
Essential Requirements:
8+ years of software engineering experience;. Ability to thrive in an AI-native, startup-style team where ambiguity is normal and execution speed matters
Proven track record of building core components of an autonomous agent platform in production (e.g., agent execution loops, planning and task decomposition, tool-calling/MCP layers, or memory and context management). Building simple LLM API wrappers or using commercial coding assistants alone is not sufficient
Experience operating long-running autonomous agents in production: isolated sandbox environments (containers or microVMs), state checkpointing/resume, failure recovery, loop and drift detection, and token/cost budgets
Deep expertise in context engineering for software agents on large, complex codebases: code indexing and retrieval, repository maps, and context compaction, with measurable improvements in task success rates
Experience with evaluation-driven agent development: designing benchmarks and evaluation suites to measure task completion, iterating on agent behavior based on metrics, and enforcing automated verification
Desirable Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
Experience deploying, extending, or integrating commercial or open-source autonomous agent platforms in an enterprise environment (including custom agents, SDK/MCP extensions, and self-hosted/private deployments)
Production experience with multi-agent systems (planner, executor, and reviewer patterns; agent handoffs), durable execution engines, published agent benchmarks, or contributions to open-source agent frameworks
About Dell Technologies — ISG Developer Experience
Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group is a global leader in Solutions, Storage, Compute, and Networking. The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our current mandate spans agentic SDLC transformation, AI tooling governance, and the operating model changes required to make AI-assisted development the norm — not the exception.
Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.
Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.
Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.
We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.
If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.
Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.
Compensation
Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $172,000 to $236,500
Benefits and Perks of Working at Dell Technologies
Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com

Software Senior Principal Engineer – Autonomous AI Software Engineering
Software engineering is being reshaped by autonomous AI agents that can plan, write, test, and review code with increasing independence. Our team works at the forefront of that shift, bringing agent-driven autonomy into the software development lifecycle so that engineers set direction and make key decisions while agents handle execution.
Because the agent landscape evolves rapidly, we stay hands-on: exploring promising approaches, validating them through rigorous experimentation on real engineering workloads, and turning successful outcomes into enterprise-grade software development practices. We are a small, AI-native team operating with startup agility—emphasizing high autonomy, rapid iteration, and seamless human-AI collaboration.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact as a Software Senior Principal Engineer on our AI Governance Engineering team in Hopkinton, Massachusetts. This is an onsite role.
What You'll Achieve
You will serve as the technical leader and architect for autonomous AI across our software development lifecycle. You will define the target architecture for agent-driven engineering, lead objective evaluations of commercial, open-source, and in-house technologies, and translate proof-of-concept results into actionable technical strategies for executive leadership.
This is a hands-on architecture role: you will write code, build critical prototypes and integrations directly, and guide engineering teams by technical example from pilot stages to enterprise-scale deployment.
You Will:
Define Reference Architectures: Architect autonomous agent systems within the SDLC, encompassing orchestration, multi-agent design patterns, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), sandboxed runtime environments, model routing, human-in-the-loop controls, and integration with existing engineering platforms and governance frameworks
Lead Technical Evaluations: Maintain deep visibility into the agent ecosystem, establish objective evaluation criteria (capability, autonomy, quality, security, scalability, extensibility, and total cost of ownership), and design proof-of-concept tests to drive build-versus-buy decisions
Own Verification and Validation: Establish the testing, qualification, and acceptance standards for agent-generated code and artifacts, including continuous benchmarking and regression monitoring for agent platforms and underlying models
Architect for Trust and Safety: Design frameworks ensuring auditability, traceability of agent actions, reproducibility, data privacy, failure containment, robust permission models, and mitigations against vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and unauthorized tool execution
Drive Platform Adoption: Establish the autonomy maturity roadmap, directly construct core platform capabilities and integrations, mentor senior technical talent, and align technical initiatives across cross-functional engineering organizations
Technologies You'll Work With:
Agents & LLMs: Commercial and open-source autonomous coding agents/frameworks, frontier and open-weight models, LLM gateways, function/tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Engineering & Integration: Python, TypeScript / Node.js, REST and GraphQL APIs, Git-based workflows, and modern CI/CD automation
Verification & Testing: Automated testing frameworks, Test-Driven Development (TDD), mutation and property-based testing, static code and security analysis, and LLM evaluation benchmarks
Runtime & Observability: Sandboxed container execution (Docker, Kubernetes), OpenTelemetry tracing, operational metrics/dashboards, and PostgreSQL
Essential Requirements:
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years as an architect or technical lead for large-scale distributed platforms
Proven track record architecting, deploying, and maintaining production-grade autonomous agent platforms (including agent runtimes, orchestration engines, tool/MCP integrations, context management, and dynamic model routing)
Demonstrated experience designing multi-agent architectures for autonomous software development (e.g., task decomposition, planner/executor/reviewer paradigms, structured agent handoffs, and human-in-the-loop validation delivering production pull requests)
Deep technical expertise in secure agent execution environments: sandboxing, workload scheduling, persistent state management, distributed tracing/replay, cost optimization, fine-grained access control, and defense-in-depth against prompt injection and sandbox escape
Direct experience building evaluation frameworks, automated benchmarking suites, and regression testing pipelines for agents, prompts, and model upgrades, backed by comprehensive knowledge of the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem
Desirable Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience scaling an agent platform from prototype to widespread enterprise adoption, or prior experience building commercial agent-based software products
Advanced familiarity with long-horizon agent reasoning techniques, including autonomous planning, reflection, self-correction, and reinforcement learning from feedback
Recognized technical leadership in agentic AI, demonstrated through open-source contributions, technical publications, patents, or benchmark releases

The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.
We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.
If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

dell-291459.text:
Senior Product Manager - AI Engineering
Showcasing excellence and innovation at every stage, Product Management is responsible for the cross-functional management of products or solutions through their entire lifecycle. Using a wealth of technical and industry experience, we work across functional areas to implement our products or solutions. We undertake thorough analysis of the markets to ensure we maximize profitability and adjust our product strategies to respond to competition. Our role also involves acting as subject matter experts for internal and external product events or partner meetings.
What you’ll achieve:
As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for delivering new AI applications and agents, discovering emerging user needs, or building product-quality proof-of-concepts in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Dojo Product Managers work on a variety of initiatives – on any given day, you might find yourself interviewing users, designing a new feature or application for our internal stakeholders, defining cutting-edge research, or managing a backlog and reviewing stories with engineers. As a part of the Dell Technologies Office of the CTO, we innovate on the future of technology in a high visibility, collaborative team. You will work with other product managers, leadership, engineers and data scientists, tech leads, strategy, and/or stakeholders to execute technology development using an agile, fast-fail mentality. This position requires someone who thrives in a highly ambiguous environment and loves to learn quickly.
Join us as a Senior Product Management in our Office of the CTO Dojo team to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact in Hopkinton, Massachusetts.
You will:
Work closely with cross-functional teams of researchers and developers, as well as with leadership, to lead the delivery of initiatives
Define and deliver full stack AI applications, agents, and capabilities
Work with users and stakeholders to understand their needs
Develop and maintain a backlog of stories and areas of exploration; prioritize work
Highlight ongoing status, goals, and plans to executives
Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:
Essential Requirements
Self-motivated, enthusiastic, energetic and passionate about technology and leading projects
Experience interfacing with customers and stakeholders to understand pain points and drive technical requirements
Ability and open mindedness to quickly learn about new development methodologies and cutting-edge technologies such as generative AI, agentic AI, data ingestion, and Dev/ MLOps
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
Experience working across and leading cross-functional teams to deliver non-deterministic software
Desirable Requirements
A bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in product management, business, software development, data science, or a similar area; a master’s degree with 6+ years of experience; or equivalent experience
Experience defining and delivering AI applications
Compensation
Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this position: $147,000 to $202,400
Benefits and Perks of working at Dell Technologies
Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member - right now at MyWellatDell.com
Here’s our story; now tell us yours
Dell Technologies helps organizations and individuals build a brighter digital tomorrow. Our company is made up of more than 150,000 people, located in over 180 locations around the world. We’re proud to be a diverse and inclusive team and have an endless passion for our mission to drive human progress.
What’s most important to us is that you are respected, feel like you can be yourself and have the opportunity to do the best work of your life -- while still having a life. We offer excellent benefits, bonus programs, flexible work arrangements, a variety of career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and much more.
We started with computers, but we didn’t stop there. We are helping customers move into the future with multi-cloud, AI and machine learning through the most innovative technology and services portfolio for the data era. Join us and become a part of what’s next in technology, starting today.
You can also learn more about us by reading our latest Diversity and Inclusion Report and our plan to make the world a better place by 2030 here .

dell-296612.text:
Security Engineer - Federal Customer
(on-site 5 days per week/Chantilly, VA - TS/SCI Required
If you enjoy working with new technologies, enterprise-leading equipment, and seek to secure and maintain compliance, we would like to speak to you. This position will play a key role in meeting critical compliance and security baselines of next-generation infrastructure to support Information Technology (IT) workloads.
You will join a diverse team of DevOps Engineers to design, deploy, maintain, and secure platform infrastructure. You will collaborate with people inside and outside the organization to deliver the highest standards for building, deploying, and securing infrastructure.
The Security Engineer is focused on automating security practices to ensure compliance with critical infrastructure. This includes traditional compliance and vulnerability scanning of switches, routers, firewalls, operating systems, applications, and platform components associated with Kubernetes. As a Security Engineer, you are responsible for the detection and mitigation of security risks to meet security requirements and maintain compliance.
Key Job Responsibilities
Security Engineers perform high-quality security assessments of network and platform components, mitigate risks, develop security automation that meets industry best practices, assist with internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate security and compliance documentation.
· Maintain high security and compliance standards through security automation
· Deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions and processes
· Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configuration issues; including low level application interaction, Linux systems, and next-gen networking software tools
· Maintain security best practices across the infrastructure to ensure systems are fully compliant with government/industry standards and policies
· Think Big, and innovate new security solutions that enable us to move faster and meet key security and compliance milestones
· Ensure the roll-out of new designs and products meet compliance and security requirements, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining platform infrastructure and tooling
Required Qualifications:
· Experience with the Authority to Operate (ATO) process, NIST SP 800-53, Cyber Security and Risk Management Frameworks, Security Center, Nessus, and log/event aggregation tools (Splunk/Wazuh/SysLog)
· Knowledge in network topologies and architectures (VLAN, LAN, WAN)
· Ability to effectively communicate with team members, vendors, and customers to understand requirements and implement solutions
· Proficient time management to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced networking environment
· Ability to operate and troubleshoot operating systems to include networking devices (Linux, Windows, Cisco IOS, Palo Alto)
· Experience managing firewall rule sets to secure infrastructure
· Knowledge with protocol analysis tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump
· 15+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree
· Active TS/SCI and the ability to maintain access as required by the program
. Candidates must be able to lift up to 25lbs.
Core Competencies - Leadership
· Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in distributed systems.
· Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with development teams, operations, security, and other stakeholders.
· Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead technical initiatives.
· Mentorship: As a Senior role, the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers, share knowledge, and foster best practices.
· Proactive & Ownership: Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential issues, with a strong sense of ownership over the platform.
· Adaptability & Continuous Learning: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to a rapidly evolving cloud-native landscape.
Preferred Qualifications:
· Proficient in either Python or Go programming language
· Experience working with RESTful APIs to automate security assessments and mitigation processes

dell-293104.text:
Consultant Machine Learning Engineer & AI Product Lead
Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte-scale data sets and shape brand-new methodologies, tools, statistical methods, and models. What’s more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts, and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact as a Consultant Machine Learning Engineer & AI Product Lead on our growing and dynamic team in Round Rock, Texas.
What you’ll achieve
Lead the technical vision, product roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of enterprise-scale machine learning solutions across Dell’s global ecosystem. As a Consultant Machine Learning Engineer & AI Product Lead , you will sit at the intersection of advanced machine learning engineering, rapid scripting and automation, product management, and semantic data integration. You will drive AI products from discovery and proof-of-concept through to production deployment, translating complex business problems into actionable technical roadmaps and robust ML systems. In addition to building high-performance ML pipelines, production-grade inference services, and automation scripts, you will leverage knowledge graph technologies to enhance data context, retrieval, and decision-making across our AI ecosystem.
You will
Lead Design and development of activities associated with software using a range of applicable technologies (e.g., programming languages, compilers, assemblers, debuggers, other tools) for products used in local, networked or Internet-related computer programs.
Drive the product strategy and technical roadmap for enterprise AI/ML initiatives, collaborating with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define & determine software & product requirements, technical specifications, and system impacts
Develop high availability and highly scalable applications which will be used by both internal and external customers.
Create technical documentation and functional test use cases.
Analyze business requirements, processes, data, and system integration points to determine and recommend appropriate technology solutions.
Establish and champion MLOps best practices, including continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), automated retraining pipelines, drift detection, and observability
Work closely with the global development team, senior Solution Architects, and executives within the Engineering group and other functions to plan ongoing feature development, product maintenance, and development team management
Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:
Essential Requirements:
10+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering, applied data science, or technical AI product leadership delivering enterprise-grade ML solutions.
Strong product management acumen with proven experience leading technical product lifecycles, defining product roadmaps, writing functional/technical specifications, and managing cross-functional stakeholder alignments.
Advanced scripting and programming proficiency in Python and Shell/Bash for rapid prototyping, automation, data engineering, and production service development.
Demonstrated experience with MLOps frameworks, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), workflow orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow), and cloud-native deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Desirable Requirements:
Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
Experience acting as a Technical Product Manager (TPM) or lead product owner in an agile ML/AI engineering environment.
Familiarity with graph query languages (Cypher, SPARQL), ontology modeling, or leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) alongside traditional predictive modeling

Senior Manager, Agentic AI Product Security Engineering
The security of customers’ data and systems is of paramount importance to Dell Technologies. Our Product Security Engineering team designs and develops software and systems to minimize security risks within our products. As experts working at the cutting edge of security, we undertake vulnerability response handling, implement the security development lifecycle, coordinate security certifications and develop common software security components and toolkits. As well as ensuring the authenticity and integrity of the product code during product development, we mitigate risks of sourcing and delivery of counterfeit or maliciously tainted components in our products.
Dell Technologies Security and Resiliency organization manages security risk across all aspects of Dell's business. We are experiencing tremendous growth as we continue to meet the security needs of one of the world's largest technology companies. With team members located in more than 15 countries, you will have an exceptional opportunity to influence Dell's security culture while advancing your career.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Manager, Agentic AI Product Security Engineering on our Security and Resiliency team in Round Rock, Texas . Relocation assistance is available.
You will:
Lead and develop a team of engineers responsible for building, evaluating, and operating AI-native security capabilities
Drive delivery execution and accountability, ensuring commitments are met through sustainable engineering practices and operational excellence
Establish and maintain a high engineering bar through direct involvement in architecture reviews, technical design, and code review
Define and continuously evolve the technical vision and roadmap for AI-native security capabilities as business needs and technology advance
Hire engineers through an interview process that tests real production experience, and grow their capability and scope through coaching
Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here ’ s what we are looking for with this role:

10+ years, or equivalent skill, of software engineering experience delivering production-scale systems; must include 3+ years of experience in an engineering management role
Strong technical depth with the ability to review architecture, evaluate technical designs, assess code quality, and lead technical decision-making across complex engineering initiatives
Hands-on experience building and operating artificial intelligence (AI)-native systems, including agentic systems, large language model (LLM) applications, evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic systems, and production AI environments
Proven track record of driving delivery accountability, setting technical direction, managing execution against commitments, and communicating priorities, trade-offs, and risks to senior leadership across large, complex, matrixed organizations
Demonstrated success hiring and developing engineers in a competitive talent market, including building an interview process that predicts performance and growing engineers' capability and scope

Experience leading engineering teams developing artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) systems for production environments, preferably within cybersecurity or security engineering organizations

dell-297384.text:
Messaging and Streaming Platform Engineer
The ability to drive human progress through technology relies on robust and reliable IT infrastructure – and that’s what our IT Infrastructure team provides to our customers. We’re a team of experts optimizing the performance and integrity of IT infrastructure and ensuring consistency and synchronization across all infrastructure components. In addition to supporting new and existing applications, we work with other IT groups and business units to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Messaging and Streaming Platform Engineer on our Dell IT team in Round Rock, Texas.
What you’ll achieve
The Messaging and Streaming Platform Engineer provides middleware messaging engineering, administration and system support for new and existing production RabbitMQ and Kafka environments, including performance of the following tasks:
Software installation, patch installation, upgrades, object definition, configuration, security, system monitoring and tuning, disaster recovery planning, automation implementation and backup and recovery.

As a Federal Cybersecurity Senior Advisor on the Security Data Management (SDM) team, you will be a key technical contributor in advancing Dell's cybersecurity visibility, threat detection, and observability capabilities. You will implement, operate, and continuously improve logging, monitoring, and data pipeline solutions that empower security teams with actionable insights and reduce response times. You will leverage technologies such as Splunk, Elastic Stack, Cribl, and NDR platforms while contributing to Dell's evolution toward AI-enabled, data-driven security operations.
This role emphasizes hands-on execution, optimization, and operational excellence — delivering reliable, high-quality security data capabilities that strengthen the organization's resilience against evolving threats.

Lead the implementation, configuration, and administration of enterprise logging and monitoring platforms, including Splunk, Elastic Stack, and Cribl , while developing dashboards, alerts, correlation searches, and reporting capabilities.
Design, build, and maintain security data pipelines , ensuring reliable log ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and data quality using tools such as Cribl and Vector .
Develop and support scalable observability and logging infrastructure leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, virtualized environments, Dell ECS, and PowerScale for data retention, monitoring, and analytics.
Create automation and integrations using Python, Bash, and PowerShell to streamline data collection, configuration management, operational processes, and security monitoring workflows.
Optimize logging platform performance and support threat detection, incident response, forensic investigations, and AI-enabled security operations through high-quality, analytics-ready data and robust observability practices.
Ensure compliance with security and regulatory frameworks including NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, and CIS , while supporting audit readiness, risk assessments, privacy requirements, and AI governance controls.
Drive platform reliability and continuous improvement by developing runbooks, monitoring service health, participating in incident response, identifying operational gaps, and implementing scalable remediation and automation solutions.
Essential Requirements
Must be a USA Citizen
You should have 10–12 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on logging, monitoring, data management, and infrastructure
Strong hands-on experience with Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Cribl , and Splunk Enterprise/Cloud and proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker , and CI/CD pipeline integration
Experience with Dell ECS, PowerScale , and virtual machine environments
Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
Strong ability to operate production systems with accountability to KPIs and outcomes
Desirable Requirements
Familiarity with NDR technologies such as NetWitness, Corelight, or ExtraHop and knowledge of additional logging/SIEM technologies: Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto Strata
Industry certifications such as: CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GMON, Splunk Certified Power User/Admin, CCNA, CCNP, PCNSA, PCNSE

· Ability to deploy and utilize local Large Language Models (LLMs)
